visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed seasonal background photo at the top of the homepage, with optional overlay text
visualCharacteristics.summary: Photo only, with no headline or CTA, and it sits behind the global nav and the topic tiles. The vanilla hero is image plus title.

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image; row 2 (optional): title, subheading, CTA
rows: Title, subheading, CTA (optional; empty on this page)
contentPattern.notes: A full-bleed photo background belongs to a hero block, so the section gets no color style.

usage: Top of a landing page when a full-bleed photo carries the section; text is optional and may be left empty.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any photo-led hero, with or without a headline. Use the base hero for a plain image-plus-title hero.
